text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: After finishing our training meeting with Taiki Shuttle...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
*fidget*... *fidget*...
...*peek*... *peek*...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm waitin' for an email reply
from my Mom and Dad!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "I sent you my favorite video that I took the other day! ...Look! This one, this one!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Papa, Mama! This is the heart of Japan, sakura!
Actually, from now on, I'm—"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Japanese soul!
Let's do some hanami cherry-blossom viewing!
Right, Fukukitaru~♪"

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: "Yes~! Daddies and everyone, come on, come on! Behold the flowers of good fortune in Japanese spring~!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Looking at this makes me so happy, yes!
So I'm sure Papa and the others will be too...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's an email from Dad!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"‘Thank you for such Kawaii photos!
Spring in Japan is wonderful♪’ ...She loves them!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "In both fashion and action, you're quite the Japanese girl now"...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...Whaaaat!? Am I no longer
a Kentucky cowgirl!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: "Because it says, 'You're totally a Japanese girl now!' DESU!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: T-That is true... I have made many precious memories in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Still—if things stay like this, all my memories
will eventually just be of Japan...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Won't all my memories of America
just disappear?!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaah! That's so lonely, *desu*!
Both are important, I don't want either to disappear, *desu*~~!
choice_data_list: It's okay, I'm not going anywhere.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
*Sniff*, but me... I've changed a lot
since when I was over there! That's why...!
choice_data_list: I'm making more and more precious memories!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Memories multiply like photos in an album.
And they will never disappear.
...That is what I told the anxious girl.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
An album of memories... from America and Japan.
...I see... That's right, that outfit too—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I picked the tunic because it's cherry blossom-colored.
But... I've always liked the star pattern on the pants, since long ago.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I love cherry blossom viewing 'cause it reminds me of BBQing with my family...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: I was... squishing together my precious memories, wasn't I, yes... Which means—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—They're not disappearing, they're multiplying, and that's happy!
Right, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Let's make even more memories together!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
—They're not disappearing, they're multiplying, and that's happy!
Right, Trainer?!
choice_data_list: Let's make even more memories together!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes! I'm sure Papa and everyone
wanted to see all my memories too...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Strike while the iron is hot☆ Let's go make some memories right away!
I'm leaving the memory photo duty to you♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yummy! I've been wanting to try this! Plus, sakura flavor is limited-time for spring, you know~♪

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Fufu♪ I went ahead and took the corner seat! Corner seats are super popular in Japan, you know~

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: And the final one to introduce is—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's Nakayama Racecourse! It's where the very hot race,
the Sprinters Stakes, is held!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Lots of super strong girls are running, YES!
But me... just like before. Fighting full of spirit!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"No... Coming to Japan and meeting you, Trainer...
I have become much, MUCH stronger than before!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Memories make me stronger... That's why
I'll make even more memories and get even stronger!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Making a spirited declaration in the video, their fighting spirit burned even brighter for the upcoming races!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Double happy, yeah!
Then let's take a video together as happy buddies!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Come on, please come stand next to me!
Here we go, okay~? One, two, three!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Papa, Mama! The two of us will be together forever and ever! Forever happy♪
choice_data_list: Isn't that phrasing a bit misleading!?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Gohay? Happy is telling the truth, yes!
So send! *Click.*"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Oh! An email from Papa and the others right away!
It's written in Japanese for you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Umm... "Trainer-san, daughter happy, us happy too!"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Yahoo! Now our happiness is parent-approved!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Did she misunderstand, or not...? The truth remains unknown, but Taiki Shuttle looks happy, so I decide to let it be.
